title: Looking for dark/black cloud tile set

posts.author: ezioking86
posts.body:
Hello,
I am looking for a tile set of dark or black clouds that would replace oceans/seas in my game.
I own RPG Maker MZ and so that is the graphic feel I'm looking for. I have my own photoshopping app, just not good at recoloring already created assets lol. Thank you for any help. If I haven't provided enough info, just say what I need to emphasize and I'll do my best. Since its replacing water, it needs to be able to be sailed on too.

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
I am not sure if I fully understand your request? Are you talking about cloads in the sky or a cloud filled sea?
Since you talk recolor, do you mean you "just" want to have the default overworld clouds in black?
If you have trouble with the recolor, let me explain: you can get there pretty smoothly by editing the color curve. Basically all advanced editing programs (Gimp, Photopea, Photoshop...) have something like this, here is a view from Gimp:
By draggin this curve around, you can adjust brightness and contrast a lot more flexible than with normal sliders, a "black" result might be something like this:
You can basically use all the different coloring tools and see what fits best, like here I did some fine tuning in the Hue-Saturation Window
...and then went back to curves for more contrast:
The good thing about a recolor that is just starting from a solid base is that you can just try over and over and switch the different options and try them out until you are happy.
TIPP: When changing brightness, contrast also usually changes and that is what makes recoloring white to black and black to white more advanced than let's say green to red. But once you understand you have to adjust the contrast, you can play around until it feels right.
